"""End-to-end verification of the PulseCart API against a running server."""
import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"


def call(method, path, body=None, headers=None, cookie=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if cookie:
        req.add_header("Cookie", cookie)
    for k, v in (headers or {}).items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            raw = r.read().decode()
            return r.status, json.loads(raw) if raw else None, r.headers.get("Set-Cookie", "")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read().decode()
        try:
            return e.code, json.loads(raw) if raw else None, ""
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return e.code, raw, ""


results = []


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    results.append((name, ok, detail))
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}  {name}  {detail}")


# 1. health
s, d, _ = call("GET", "/api/health")
check("health", s == 200 and d.get("status") == "ok", f"status={s} body={d}")

# 2. categories
s, cats, _ = call("GET", "/api/categories")
check("categories", s == 200 and len(cats) >= 4, f"count={len(cats) if isinstance(cats,list) else cats}")

# 3. products list + shape
s, prods, _ = call("GET", "/api/products?limit=5")
items = prods.get("products", prods) if isinstance(prods, dict) else prods
check("products list", s == 200 and len(items) >= 5, f"count={len(items)}")
p0 = items[0]
check("product fields", all(k in p0 for k in ("id", "title", "price_cents", "stock")), f"keys={list(p0.keys())}")

# 4. search
s, srch, _ = call("GET", "/api/products?q=head")
sitems = srch.get("products", srch) if isinstance(srch, dict) else srch
check("search q=head", s == 200 and len(sitems) >= 1, f"matches={len(sitems)}")

# 5. category filter
slug = cats[0]["slug"]
s, filt, _ = call("GET", f"/api/products?category={slug}")
fitems = filt.get("products", filt) if isinstance(filt, dict) else filt
all_match = all(x.get("category") == cats[0]["name"] or x.get("category_slug") == slug for x in fitems)
check("category filter", s == 200 and len(fitems) >= 1 and all_match,

s, one, _ = call("GET", f"/api/products/{p0['id']}")
check("product detail", s == 200 and one.get("id") == p0["id"], f"id={p0['id']}")

check("add to cart", s in (200, 201) and cart.get("count", 0) >= 2, f"status={s} count={cart.get('count')}")

# 8. get cart
s, cart2, _ = call("GET", "/api/cart", cookie=cookie)
total = cart2.get("subtotal_cents", 0)
check("get cart", s == 200 and cart2.get("count", 0) >= 2,
      f"count={cart2.get('count')} subtotal={total}")

# 8b. cart totals math
expected = sum(i["price_cents"] * i["quantity"] for i in cart2.get("items", []))
check("cart subtotal correct", total == expected, f"expected={expected} got={total}")

# 9. update quantity
item_id = cart2["items"][0]["id"] if cart2.get("items") else p0["id"]
s, upd, _ = call("PATCH", f"/api/cart/items/{item_id}", {"quantity": 3}, cookie=cookie)
check("update qty", s == 200, f"status={s}")

# 10. checkout
s, order, _ = call("POST", "/api/checkout",
                   {"email": "test@example.com", "name": "Test Buyer", "address": "1 Main St"},
                   cookie=cookie)
ok_order = s in (200, 201) and (order.get("order_id") or order.get("id"))
check("checkout", bool(ok_order), f"status={s} order={order.get('order_id') or order.get('id')}")
order_id = order.get("order_id") or order.get("id")

# 11. cart cleared after checkout
s, cart3, _ = call("GET", "/api/cart", cookie=cookie)
check("cart cleared after checkout", cart3.get("count", 0) == 0, f"count={cart3.get('count')}")

# 12. stock decremented
s, after, _ = call("GET", f"/api/products/{p0['id']}")
check("stock decremented", after["stock"] == p0["stock"] - 2,
      f"before={p0['stock']} after={after['stock']}")

# 13. admin unauthorized
s, _, _ = call("GET", "/api/admin/orders")
check("admin blocked without key", s in (401, 403), f"status={s}")

# 14. admin authorized
s, orders, _ = call("GET", "/api/admin/orders", headers={"X-Admin-Key": "admin-secret"})

# 16. admin create product
s, newp, _ = call("POST", "/api/products",

check("admin create product", s in (200, 201) and (newp.get("id") or newp.get("product_id")),
      f"status={s}")

# 17. admin update stock
if newp.get("id") or newp.get("product_id"):
    nid = newp.get("id") or newp.get("product_id")
    s, _, _ = call("PATCH", f"/api/products/{nid}", {"stock": 42},
                   headers={"X-Admin-Key": "admin-secret"})
    check("admin update product", s == 200, f"status={s}")

# 18. bad input rejected
s, _, _ = call("POST", "/api/cart/items", {"product_id": 999999, "quantity": 1})
check("invalid product rejected", s >= 400, f"status={s}")

s, _, _ = call("POST", "/api/cart/items", {"product_id": p0["id"], "quantity": -5})
check("negative qty rejected", s >= 400, f"status={s}")

# 19. order status update
if order_id:
    s, _, _ = call("PATCH", f"/api/orders/{order_id}/status", {"status": "shipped"},
                   headers={"X-Admin-Key": "admin-secret"})
    check("order status update", s == 200, f"status={s}")

# 20. 404 on unknown api route
s, _, _ = call("GET", "/api/nope")
check("unknown route 404", s == 404, f"status={s}")

# 21. frontend served
req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/")
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
    html = r.read().decode()
check("frontend served", r.status == 200 and "<html" in html.lower(), f"len={len(html)}")

# 22. path traversal blocked / static safe
s, _, _ = call("GET", "/../app.py")
check("no traversal of app.py", "import sqlite3" not in str(call("GET", "/../app.py")[1]), f"status={s}")

passed = sum(1 for _, ok, _ in results if ok)
print(f"\n{'='*50}\n{passed}/{len(results)} checks passed")
raise SystemExit(0 if passed == len(results) else 1)

import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
ADMIN_KEY = "admin-secret"

PASS = 0
FAIL = 0


def call(method, path, body=None, headers=None, cookie=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if cookie:
        req.add_header("Cookie", cookie)
    for k, v in (headers or {}).items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            raw = r.read().decode()
            return r.status, (json.loads(raw) if raw else None), r.headers.get("Set-Cookie", "")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read().decode()
        try:
            return e.code, (json.loads(raw) if raw else None), ""
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return e.code, raw, ""
